term.label: methylation_guide_snoRNA_gene

definition.text: A gene that codes for methylation_guide_snoRNA. A snoRNA that specifies the site of 2'-O-ribose methylation in an RNA molecule by base pairing with a short sequence around the target residue.

comments: Added at the request of Steven Marygold. See GitHub Issue #519 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/519).
